props.title: JSON renders this Nuxt page
props.description: The page structure lives in data. Nuxt only decides which component should render each block.

items.title: Composable
items.description: Each section is a small component with a clear contract.

items.title: Editable
items.description: Changing the JSON changes the page without rewriting templates.

items.title: Portable
items.description: The same schema could later come from a CMS API.

props.title: First principle
props.body: A page builder does not store Vue components. It stores component names and data. The frontend owns how that data becomes UI.
